meta.title: About
meta.description: About Adhitya Harisudhakar, a junior at Innovation Academy studying epoxy-sealed 3D-printed PLA for AP Research.

portraitAlt: Black and white portrait of Adhitya Harisudhakar standing outdoors, with a lake and hills in the background.
bio: My name is Adhitya Harisudhakar. I am a junior at Innovation Academy, and I am deeply passionate about medicine, technology, and engineering.

Combining my passions, I have dedicated my junior year's research project to analyzing how 3D printing has the potential to be used as an alternative to stainless steel in medical facilities located in low-income areas.
Specifically, I want to evaluate how well 3D-printed parts hold up against stress and liquids, and how those factors are affected by surface coatings.

facts.label: Project
facts.value: Epoxy sealing and repeated alcohol disinfection of 3D-printed PLA
